parameters.name: ParameterGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the parameter template.

> You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](~~207178~~) operation to query the details of all parameter templates of a specified region, such as the ID of a parameter template.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

>You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query all regions that are available within your account, such as the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-parameter-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-type MySQL --parameter-group-id pcpg-00000000000000 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
